beats.say: Walter Koenig has passed away at the age of 90.
The actor was born in Chicago on 14 September 1936 before finding fame.
He became a household name playing Ensign Pavel Chekov in Star Trek.
His bond with his co stars lasted for decades after the show.
In 2008, Koenig served as the best man at George Takei's wedding.
He remained a central figure in the franchise until 25 October 2026.
By living to 90, he became one of the longest lived original bridge crew.
